decisions.title: Release-path scope
decisions.summary: Change the bodies of Conserved, Contained (loop 2 test) and Check's capacity condition, and the Integer_Matches body; additive Prefix Post conjunct, Integer_Token, Binary_At Post, Integer_Matches Global. Exact_Value/Amount/Sum, every *_Reference, every public Post, the C exports and all Python stay unchanged. Helpers (OD-1), D2, Python (OD-2), transport and physical resources stay OPEN.

decisions.title: Signed side split with normalized selection
decisions.summary: Sides by raw sign flag; the target goes on the opposite side; L - R = sum - Value(Target). Normalized replaces invalid spans by the empty quantity before Compare, so Usage_Selected equals the Amount_Reference value test on the whole domain.

decisions.title: Representable column arithmetic
decisions.summary: type Column_Total is range 0 .. 2**71 (128-bit base or the unit is rejected); widen before arithmetic; Rows'Length + 1 never formed in Byte_Count; no carry-draining column; residual-carry closing theorem.

decisions.title: Post-free executable helpers (DR-C1)
decisions.summary: Effective_Length, Normalized, Usage_Selected, Operand and Selected are Post-free expression functions; their value facts are lemmas (LA-9, LA-10) called once per proof point instead of Q.Value-based Posts evaluated per row per column under -gnata.

decisions.title: Ghost model A-GHOST-1 (primary) or A-GHOST-0
decisions.owner: lead (choice conditional on the operator's R-1 decision)
decisions.summary: A-GHOST-1: one new recursive ghost expression function Side_Sum (term selector Prefix/Digit, no Post), expected to draw [contracts-recursive]/[numeric-variant] like Sum_Reference; the notice joins the R-1 class and stays OPEN. A-GHOST-0: notice-free; pinned Sum_Reference over ghost truncated-row aggregates, at about K times the checked cost. A-GHOST-0 replaces A-GHOST-1 if R-1's decision does not cover new D1 sites.

decisions.title: Installed shape rules for loops
decisions.summary: No declarations in loop bodies before invariants (non-scalar unsupported, constants warn); temporaries hoisted; no ineffective initialization; explicit left-association parentheses for mixed additive chains.

decisions.title: Explicit lemma contracts; iterative induction (DR-C3)
decisions.summary: LA-1..LA-11 and Lemma_Close as ghost procedures with Global => null, Always_Terminates and full bodies; induction over rows or columns written as loops; no imported, justified or assumed lemma; per-package copies of the Column_Bounds/Higher_Column_Order/Prefix_Padding patterns.

decisions.title: Check capacity branch via Pair_Sum_Order
decisions.summary: Only the capacity condition changes; branch order and statuses byte-identical; Capacity_Fits remains rejected as primary because it is correct only under Shape.

decisions.title: Single Both_Kinds pass in Contained
decisions.summary: The aggregate held+budget inequality is decided directly with the two-valued Charge_Kind partition lemma (LA-10); per-kind inequalities are not used; RL-22 discriminates.

decisions.title: Work shape: P.Bytes (1 .. B.Length), no sentinel cell, scalar carry-out
decisions.summary: S1..S6: First = 1, length = B.Length (null when 0), all zero initially, no contract index outside Work'Range, bounds fixed, overflow = Carry_Out /= 0. A null Work is legal and never indexed; Multiply_Add's Pre has no indexing. Pinned Q.Prefix_Reference gives the value, so no new recursive function and no B.Length + 1. B-SHAPE-S (v2 sentinel with nonempty Pre) is recorded, not selected.

decisions.title: Digit-shape proof interface
decisions.summary: PFX-1 primary: additive public Post conjunct on Prefix plus public ghost Integer_Token, proved by a new digit-loop invariant; existing conjuncts and variant byte-identical. Alternatives: PFX-2 Refined_Post (spec byte-identical; probe P-PFX2), PFX-3 private core plus wrapper (variant-not-recursive warning risk), PFX-5 general-addend arithmetic. PFX-4 rejected. The v2 no-fallback claim is withdrawn.

decisions.title: Reference: original statements in ghost lockstep (B-REF-L)
decisions.summary: Decide_Work executes the original decimal and binary statements verbatim as ghost code alongside the work-array algorithm, and asserts Result = (Decimal_Value = Binary_Value) at every return (overflow, mismatch, match). Finish_Decimal and Finish_Binary are ghost procedures whose bodies are the original statements and whose Posts are bounds. No new recursive function; no recursion. D-B-SPEC (v2 functional Post on Integer_Matches) withdrawn; B-REF-R (v2 closed references) kept as an alternative.

decisions.title: Split into Integer_Matches, Decide_Work, Multiply_Add
decisions.summary: Integer_Matches holds the verbatim guard, allocation, one call and frees, with no loops, so no loop invariant ever sits in a handler-protected list. Loops live in Decide_Work, Multiply_Add (integer-only invariants, Old_Work and Carry_In ghost, value-'Old Post) and the ghost procedures.

decisions.title: Workspace lifetime on every exit
decisions.summary: CL-1 primary: pool-specific owner, initialized allocator, Free on the normal exit, and a handler that frees and re-raises the same occurrence. Per Appendix B.2 the handler sits on an inner block enclosing only the Decide_Work call (RM 11.6). Gated by probes P-W1..P-W8; P-W3, no unreachable-code warning, is a real risk (F21, F22). The v2 claim that no other exit exists is withdrawn.
